newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: GUATEMALA JULY CONSUMER PRICES RISE 0.45 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: GUATEMALA JULY CONSUMER PRICES RISE 0.45 PERCENT.

text.p: Guatemalan consumer prices rose 0.45 percent in July, compared to a rise of 1.37 percent in the same month last year, the National Statistics Institute said on Monday.
June prices rose 0.05 percent this year.
Cumulative inflation was 4.08 percent from January to the end of July, compared with 6.85 percent in the same period a year ago, the institute said.
Year-over-year inflation was 7.98 percent on July 31, down from 8.97 percent as of June 30. Year-over-year inflation at the end of July 1996 was 11.60 percent.
